grounding.method: Actual decoded footskin at120Hz determines a nonnegative C1 root lift. Piecewise Hermite keyheights at30Hz have zero additive tangents at everykey, preserving original endpoint derivatives. Generic transitions add smooth moving-foot clearance up to25mm; retained gait transitions are exempt. The transition may contain a short hop.

qa.rubric: Locally authored rubric; requested external motion-qa-v1 tool was unavailable. No external certification.

integration.rootMotion: Root translation is authored world travel. Position the actor in an outer Group. Align the next animation using bridge.from/to.rootOffsetMeters, also offset MotionBallAnchor.
integration.ball: Attach a radius .12m basketball to scene node MotionBallAnchor; scale zero hides it. Gameplay determines possession, rim/recipient and world flight.
integration.referenceRun: One forward cycle, relative Root travel. Accumulate terminal displacement before repeating; do not reset Root abruptly.
integration.hands: 18 bones have no finger joints. Independent grip_left/right morphs shape thumb/fingers; these are baked glTF weight channels.
